note: The Climb's relic roster. Effects are code (RelicEffect); this is only the roster, so a new relic ships as a commit rather than an app release. An entry naming an effect an older install has never heard of is dropped by that install, not fatal to it.

relics.name: Lion's Hide
relics.description: Shrugs off your first two wrong answers.

relics.name: Scarred Hide
relics.description: Shrugs off your first four wrong answers.

relics.description: Twenty more health for the rest of the climb.
